author: Nintendo of America
description:
Put your Dandori skills to the test in Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy. Available now: https://ninten.do/6003x6zPb

The Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy Upgrade Pack is also available.

Take on the challenges in the new mode, Dandori Academy, and unlock in-game rewards! Plus, check out improved visuals and give commands to your loyal pup, Oatchi, using the built-in microphone on the Nintendo Switch 2 system.

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
